title: Simply Nature in the City
description:
The space
Escape to a one-of-a-kind outdoor adventure where privacy, comfort, and a true countryside glamping experience come together. Nestled on a spacious multi-acre property in Smyrna, Tennessee, and just eight minutes away from historic Nolensville, Tennessee. This unforgettable treehouse retreat offers a perfect blend of relaxation, nature, and unique amenities designed to create lasting memories. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, celebrating a special occasion, or simply seeking a peaceful retreat, you'll find plenty of ways to unwind and reconnect with nature.

 Property Notes:

-You may encounter wildlife and friendly animals during your stay.
-To respect your privacy, Jamie will coordinate any necessary visits to feed the chickens and will do so at a time that minimizes any interruption to your stay.
-Come experience a truly unique Tennessee getaway where nature, comfort, and unforgettable memories await.
-Play a competitive game of Boccee ball, take a dip in the hot tub, make a meal in the outdoor kitchen and bar, roast marshmallows around our firepit. Soak up the sun just above the trees in the Nashville mountain skies. 

Our Treehouse will be a priceless memory you will cherish forever!

-Guests must be comfortable climbing stairs and ladders.
-There are 18 steps to access the loft and main living areas.
-The rooftop shower requires climbing a 9-step ladder.
-Open loft sleeping area includes an air mattress.
-Bathroom is shared with the loft space.
-This is a rustic treehouse glamping experience with outdoor elements.
*Not recommended for guests with cedar allergies.
